notes: Claim numbering is approximate per sentence in document order (summary c01, keyPoints c02-c06, body c07-c55); per-claim urls are generic, see notes. Evidence pages: nhs.uk methods, how-well-it-works, where-to-get-contraception, contraceptive-injection, vasectomy, england.nhs.uk pharmacy service, 111.wales combined pill, NICE CG30 informationforpublic. Removed unsupported sentences; added supported ones (injection 8 or 13 weeks, implant now 5 years per NHS, typical-use percentages, pharmacy service scope). Emergency pill timings (3/5 days, IUD 5 days) rest on NHS sexual health service pages, not nhs.uk itself. The 3-year implant figure from NICE CG30 is dated, flagged in text.
